'''''Emperor's Eyes''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available<ref name="SWGpainting" /> in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="timing">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Opening Crawl}} places the events of the [[Star Wars video games|game]] after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], which occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> The painting depicted an [[Artist/Legends|artist's]] sketch of a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] variant called the [[TIE Sentinel]]. The Sentinel shared features of<ref name="SWGpainting" /> the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]]<ref name="Advanced">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|TIE Advanced}}</ref> and the [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE Aggressor]],<ref name="Aggressor">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|TIE Aggressor}}</ref> with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] modules protruding from the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] chassis.<ref name="SWGpainting" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Emperor's Eyes'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.<ref name="SWGpainting" /> The image is featured in the art book that accompanied the game's collector's edition, ''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="Artbook">''[[From Pencil to Pixel: The Art of Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref> The painting could be used in a player's house as a decoration.<ref name="SWGpainting" />

''Emperor's Eyes'' was one of nine paintings given out randomly to players of the game for its first anniversary of release in the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]] and [[Wikipedia:Europe|Europe]],<ref name="SWGpainting" /> and was later added to the "[[W:c:swg:Rare Loot System|Rare Loot System]]" in [[W:c:swg:Hotfix 17.10|Hotfix 17.10]]<ref name="Hotfix">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Current%20update#gu1710|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Hotfix 17.10}}</ref> on [[October 7]], [[2010]].<ref name="Hotfix 17">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68952&month=102010|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 17.10 -- Thursday, October 7, 2010}}</ref> This allowed all players to loot rare items, including ''Emperor's Eyes'', from any enemy in the game<ref name="Hotfix" /> prior to its shutdown on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
